# Tests: activity-log coverage for enriched entries + net row

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F1 — test-first verification slice, parent AC5 tests part).

## Goal

Extend `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` to assert the enriched entry formats (cost + effective deltas) and the per-turn net summary row, establishing the expected formats before implementation; update any existing assertions that match old entry text.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` asserts enriched entry text (cost + effective coin/rep deltas) and `gain|loss|neutral` type for: played event from hand, business purchase, community-space purchase, upgrade purchase, buy-and-place (incl. premium), hand and slot sell, community favour exchange, re-roll market, staff hire/layoff, staff/community/business ongoing costs, income phase (incl. negative income), incident resolution.
- AC2: Net-row presence + format (`Turn N net: ...`) asserted for a full turn, incl. the zero-net case and the parent-AC3-defined early game-over behaviour.
- AC3: Existing assertions matching the pre-change entry text are updated to the new canonical formats in the same change.
- AC4: `npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` passes; no other unit tests regress (`npx vitest run --project unit tests/main-street/`).

- Traceability: implements parent AC5 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC5 — Tests and docs.** `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` extended
## Minimal Implementation

- Scripted-turn fixtures with known deltas (reuse existing test helpers in `tests/main-street/`).
- Assert exact substrings built from the shared `describeEventEffects` style (`+3 coins, +2 rep`); assert `Turn N net: ...` placement/format.
- Update any tests asserting old entry text as part of this change so the suite defines the contract first (red → green as F2-F4 implement).

## Key Files

- tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts
- tests/main-street/activity-log-rendering.test.ts (verify only, no accept-format changes here)

## Constraints

- Expected formats derive from the parent brief (AC1/AC2/AC3): entries keep existing substrings (name, slot, €cost); net row emitted even when net is zero.
- Structured transcript recording (`recordMainStreetEvent`) is outside this item's scope.
data.title: Tests: activity-log coverage for enriched entries + net row

# Played-event-from-hand log entry: cost + effective deltas

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F2 — parent AC2).

## Goal

`playEventFromHand` (MainStreetMarket.ts) logs its cost plus the effective (post-mitigation) coin/reputation deltas, matching the incident/held-event format, and the entry type uses the net effect classification instead of the raw cost.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: Entry reads `Played event X from hand (-€5 cost, +3 coins, +2 rep)` — cost AND effective deltas (post staff buffs / Brand Ambassador / reputation multiplier via the existing resolve-event path).
- AC2: Entry type uses `classifyEffect(netCoin, netRep)` (net coin+rep), not the raw cost; may be `gain`, `loss`, or `neutral`.
- AC3: `describeEventEffects` and `classifyEffect` are exported from `MainStreetEngine.ts` (or moved to a shared module) and reused — not duplicated — by the played-hand path; incident/held-event entries keep identical output.
- AC4: F1 played-hand-event log tests pass.

- Traceability: implements parent AC2 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC2 — Played-from-hand event entries.** `playEventFromHand` logs cost plus
## Minimal Implementation

- Export `describeEventEffects` + `classifyEffect` from `MainStreetEngine.ts`.
- In `playEventFromHand` (MainStreetMarket.ts ≈L603-619): capture resourceBank deltas around `resolveEvent(state, event)`; append `(cost, effects)` via the shared formatter; reclassify via `classifyEffect`.

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts (playEventFromHand ≈L603-619)
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts (describeEventEffects/classifyEffect L347-364; resolveEvent L443)
- tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts

## Constraints

- Only human-readable log text changes; `recordMainStreetEvent` transcript recording unchanged.
- Undo command snapshots capture `activityLog` wholesale (MainStreetCommands.ts) — new entry shape must remain cloneable (plain serializable fields only).

# All resource-mutating log entries gain effective deltas

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F3 — parent AC1; excludes the played-hand event path covered by F2).

## Goal

Every resource-mutating action currently logged with partial info (cost-only, coin-only, or text-only) gains its effective post-mitigation coin/rep deltas, reusing the shared formatter from F2.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: Effective (actual resourceBank change) coin/rep deltas are appended to entries for: business purchase, community-space purchase, upgrade purchase, buy-and-place (incl. premium), sell from hand, sell from slot, community favour exchange (both directions), re-roll market, staff hire, staff layoff, staff/community-space/business ongoing costs, income phase (incl. negative-income cases), incident resolution (verify already-compliant; align formatting).
- AC2: Entries preserve existing substrings (card name, slot index, €cost) and stay one line where possible; classification uses the net effect via `classifyEffect` where it is currently a fixed literal.
- AC3: No unbounded text — entries stay compact for the ~300px scrollable panel (word-wrap already supported).
- AC4: F1 log tests for the covered action types pass; full unit suite green.
- AC5: The `Market cycled...` entry is left unchanged (its removal belongs to CG-0MT5VXSSQ003O5ZC).

- Traceability: implements parent AC1 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC1 — Full effects on all resource-mutating entries.** Every action that
## Minimal Implementation

- Capture pre/post `resourceBank` deltas at each site (per-action, not aggregated across the turn) and append deltas via the shared formatter; reclassify via `classifyEffect`.
- Align incident/held-event entries through the shared helpers without changing their output.

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarket.ts (purchase/place/move/upgrade/hire/sell/re-roll sites L285-977)
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts (community favour L696, layoff L1555, ongoing costs L1429-1553, incident L624)
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetAdjacency.ts (income/rep/synergy L800-808)
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts (sell-dialog log entry)
- tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts

## Constraints

- Effective values only (actual resourceBank deltas), never raw card values; reuse the F2 shared formatter.
- Structured transcript recording unchanged; undo snapshots remain cloneable (MainStreetCommands.ts).
- Any action discovered to need richer logging beyond the AC1 list becomes a follow-up work item — no scope creep.
data.title: All resource-mutating log entries gain effective deltas

# Per-turn net coin/rep summary row in activity log

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F4 — parent AC3).

## Goal

Append a single per-turn aggregate entry (`Turn N net: +12 coins, +1 rep`) at end of turn, computed from a day-start snapshot vs end-of-turn values.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: A single aggregate row `Turn N net: +X coins, +Y rep` is appended during end-of-turn processing (after ongoing costs + incident), computed as end-of-turn minus day-start resourceBank values; emitted even when the net is zero (`Turn 2 net: +0 coins, +0 rep`).
- AC2: Early game-over paths in `processEndOfTurn` define net-row behaviour (emitted before the game-over entry, or suppressed) — the choice is documented and covered by tests.
- AC3: The day-start snapshot survives save/load and replay: carried in `MainStreetState` clone/restore/serialization, or recomputable from logged data.
- AC4: Undo (command snapshots of `activityLog` in MainStreetCommands.ts) remains cloneable with the new entry shape.
- AC5: F1 net-row tests pass; full unit suite green.

- Traceability: implements parent AC3 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC3 — Per-turn net summary row.** A single aggregate entry such as
## Minimal Implementation

- Snapshot coins/rep in `executeDayStart` (new `MainStreetState` field when snapshotting).
- Compute delta at the end of `processEndOfTurn` (after ongoing costs/incident, before/at game-over handling per AC2) and emit via `addLog` with sensible classification.
- Wire the snapshot field through `MainStreetState` clone/restore and serialization (or derive from the log during load for replay).

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/MainStreetEngine.ts (executeDayStart L917; processEndOfTurn L962)
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetState.ts (LogEntry/addLog L55-89; clone/restore/serialization)
- example-games/main-street/MainStreetCommands.ts (undo command snapshots)
- tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts

## Constraints

- Effective values only; snapshot must be replay-safe (deterministic from logged data or persisted).
- Structured transcript recording unchanged; the new row is a human-readable log entry only.
data.title: Per-turn net coin/rep summary row in activity log

# Docs update + full-suite regression verification

Plan child of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ (F5 — parent AC4 + AC5 docs and suite gates).

## Goal

Update documentation to reflect the enriched log formats and the per-turn net row, verify no regression in log rendering mechanics, and run the full quality gates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- AC1: Documentation updated where it specifies log/entry formats or activity-log behaviour: check `docs/main-street/prd-milestone-3.md`, `docs/main-street/prd-balance-process-and-tooling.md`, `README.md`, `docs/DEVELOPER.md`; update code comments at changed sites.
- AC2: Browser log-rendering tests pass with mechanics unchanged: scroll/auto-scroll in `refreshLog`, gain/loss/neutral colouring, word-wrap for the existing entry-count handling.
- AC3: Full `npm test` passes (unit, browser, tutorial E2E) and `npm run build` succeeds.
- AC4: No regression: log entries remain one line where possible; auto-scroll behaviour preserved.

- Traceability: implements parent AC4 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC4 — No regression in log readability/mechanics.** Entries remain one line
- Traceability: implements parent AC5 of CG-0MT5W7UJJ0065MEZ — **AC5 — Tests and docs.** `tests/main-street/activity-log.test.ts` extended
## Minimal Implementation

- Doc text updates (log-format references only; no process/infra changes expected — if infra docs must change, follow the doc-update policy).
- Run browser log-rendering tests (`npx vitest run --project browser tests/main-street/activity-log-rendering*.browser.test.ts`), then full `npm test` and `npm run build`; fix any regressions.

## Key Files

- docs/main-street/prd-milestone-3.md
- docs/main-street/prd-balance-process-and-tooling.md
- README.md, docs/DEVELOPER.md (only if they specify log formats)
- tests/main-street/activity-log-rendering.test.ts + activity-log-rendering.browser.test.ts
- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetRenderer.ts (refreshLog — verify only, not modified unless a regression is found)

## Dependencies

- F2, F3, F4 complete (formats final) before docs/suite verification.
data.title: Docs update + full-suite regression verification
